messages:
deploy-bot: Finished rollout for service/inference-router v2026.3 -> prod (canary->80%). post-deploy smoke scheduled for eu1,us-east1.
sam: heads-up: our synthetic heartbeat for eu1 shows a gap 03:07-03:14 UTC, probe events missing, healthchecks still green from LB.
anya: looking now. LB health ok, pods report READY. No errors in service logs for requests.
tomas: can you paste the smoke probe logs? maybe the scheduler job failed to kick off.
sam: grabbing logs from smoke-runner, here's the tail:
```
2026-03-18T03:06:59Z probe-scheduler: next run in 60s
2026-03-18T03:07:00Z probe-dispatcher: dispatch start
2026-03-18T03:07:00Z probe-dispatcher: ERROR: failed to enqueue job: dial tcp 10.2.5.8:5678: i/o timeout
2026-03-18T03:07:01Z probe-dispatcher: retrying
... no dispatch until 03:14
```
anya: looks like the dispatcher couldn't reach the probe-worker cluster IP. Might be a CNI or node routing blip.
infra-bot: node eu1-probe-3 reported kubelet network flaps at 03:06:45. Pods restarted: probe-worker (x1)
tomas: that matches. probe-worker restarted and missed the scheduled window. This is a missed synthetic, not user traffic.
sam: user traffic metrics show normal qps and no error spikes. I think rollback unnecessary. Recommendation: restart probe-dispatcher on eu1 and backfill any critical probe runs.
anya: agree. I'll trigger a rolling restart of the smoke-runner deployment and enqueue a replay job for the 7m gap.
sam: doing restart:
```
kubectl -n smoke-tests rollout restart deployment/smoke-runner --selector=region=eu1
```
deploy-bot: Rollout restart initiated for deployment/smoke-runner eu1 by sam; tracking: https://deployments.internal/rollouts/3821
infra-bot: restart completed on eu1-probe-0, eu1-probe-1, eu1-probe-3. probe-dispatcher now healthy.
anya: replay job submitted: ENG-4521 (smoke-replay, eu1, 2026-03-18T03:07-03:14). Will monitor.
sam: monitoring dashboards — synthetic counter backfilled and alert cleared. :white_check_mark:
tomas: action items: (1) add a retry/backoff for enqueue failures in dispatcher, (2) alert on probe-worker restarts during scheduled windows, (3) link ENG-4521 in release notes.
anya: I'll capture root cause if flaps repeat. closing thread for now. :eyes:
